body:
[A587] TAKEN
Branch: `640-m7` from dev `e8454e27` (local, not pushed). Executor [A587]; reviewers [R592] (internal) and [R593] (external).
Authoritative references: assignment [6097272538](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/640#issuecomment-6097272538); `docs/design/MARK_II_AREA_PLAN.md` "L10 Fabric gPTP", the ledger and the firmware block-RAM ledger; `docs/design/AREA_BUDGET.md` (resource gate policy, D7); `docs/testing/PP_SHADOW_BASELINE_RECIPE.md` (M0s recipe); decisions D1, D3, D7 and D8 ([5990755268](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/640#issuecomment-5990755268)) and the owner's block-RAM decision ([6081706413](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/640#issuecomment-6081706413)); `hdl/ieee8021as/gptp_plane/KL_gptp_shadow.sv` and the gPTP processor's `KL_gptp_engine`, `KL_gptp_ucpu` and `KL_gptp_tx_slot` as the parent instantiates them.
Interpreted scope: measure first. The routed census of dev `e8454e27` (equal to the `route-1x1` record) gives the plane 508 LUTRAM LUTs: engine `bank_r` 64x64 (86), `scratch_r` 64x64 (64), `ann_ctx_r` 32x64 (44), `evq_pd_ctx_r` 4x144 (96), `evq_r` 4x40 (20); the micro-CPU's three-read operand file `rf_r` (132, kept); the TX slot (24); and the shadow's `tsf_r` 32x64 (44). I will move a table into block RAM, or narrow its index, only where the integrated image loses LUTs with identical function: same widths, depths actually used, read results, ordering, reset behaviour, and every gPTP timing, turnaround and timestamp contract. Any read-latency change gets a stated, tested deterministic bound. No register-map, wire or timestamp-path change. The gate holds RAMB36/RAMB18 at zero growth, so a conversion that needs a new tile goes to the manager as a decision, not into the branch. Engine changes live in the gPTP processor submodule: I will commit them there locally and move the parent pin, unpushed, for the manager to publish submodule first. D7 keeps the record until M9, so I will not run `record --write`.
Validation plan: per-table lockstep tests against the current storage with planted wrong-depth, wrong-read-latency and index-aliasing defects, each failing a named check; the gPTP processor's `contract`, `tb`, `lint` and `docs` targets; parent suites `gptp_plane`, `gptp_shadow`, `gptp_txts`, `milan_dp_gptp`, `ptp_ts`, `ptp_sync`, `ptp`, `clkvalid` and `cdc` in both shapes; lint on the pinned Verilator; out-of-context primitive mapping per table; the integrated route through the M0s recipe under the host lock, with the gate `check` against `route-1x1` (every endpoint passing, WNS at or above the floor, no exception); and the doc, source-list and diff gates the change touches, all rc 0 and none piped.
Blockers: none.
